notes.title: Release 1.06
notes.notes:
Sometimes in the later stages the game can be too difficult, almost impossible.
To help players weather this storm, an adaptive difficulty system has been introduced that takes into account the successes and failures of the player.

In this regard, several new achievements have also been added.

Good luck fighting the Darkness!

notes.title: Release 1.05
Release!
notes.notes:
I am glad to say that the development of TD Worlds has been successfully completed and the game is available for everyone!

To celebrate such an event, there will be a 10% discount all week.
